# Pinned, exact versions -- generated by resolving `pip install -e ".[webapp,dev]"`
# into a clean virtualenv and freezing it (this is the whole dependency
# tree, not just the direct ones pyproject.toml/requirements.txt name).
# pyproject.toml/requirements.txt stay the source of truth for FLOORS
# (">="); this file is for reproducing the exact combination that was
# actually tested, on 2026-08-27, Python 3.11, so two machines standing this
# up months apart do not silently land on different numpy/pandas/streamlit
# builds with different behaviour.
#
# Regenerate after bumping a floor in pyproject.toml:
#   python -m venv /tmp/lockenv && /tmp/lockenv/bin/pip install -e ".[webapp,dev]"
#   /tmp/lockenv/bin/pip freeze | grep -v "^-e " | sort > requirements-lock.txt
# then run the full suite against it before committing the new file.
#
# Install with: pip install -r requirements-lock.txt -e .
